topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I found a package on my doorstep today, addressed to someone who no longer lives here. It must be for the previous tenant. I could have simply left it there or taken it to the post office, but I thought about how disappointed someone might be if their package never arrived. So, I took a few minutes to look up the name online and found a local address. I'll drop it off there later. It’s a small gesture, but I hope it makes a difference.
